book.name: Matoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Matoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Sarges Xeygettida Asata Leemiso
Qasseka Yesusi hara leemiso,
«Salo Kawoteththi ba naas sarge giigsida issi kawo misatawus.
Kawoykka diggisas yootidayta xeyganaas ba ashkarata yeddides; xeygettidaytikka, ‹Nu bookko› gida.
«Qasseka hara ashkarata, ‹Kase isttas yootidayta hekko ta sanga booratanne modhdhida meheta shukkada diggisa giigsadis; wurikka giigettida gishshas sargeso haa yiite!› giidi yootite.
Xeygettidayti gidikko iza xeyssaa wudan yeggontta aggidi issoy ba goshshasoho, issoy ba zal7eso bides.
Hankko attidayta ashkarati oykkidi daro waayisidi wodhida.
«Kawoykka hanqettidi wottadarata yeddidi ashkaraza wodhidayta dhayssides; istta katamaa xuuggides.
Ba ashkaratakka, ‹Sargeza diggisay giigides; gido attiin sargezaso xeygettidayti sarges bessizayta gidibeettenna.
Gede oge bolla kezidi intte demmida as ubbaa haa diggisaso xeygite› gides.
Ashkaratikka oge bolla kezidi ba demmidayta lo7otakka iitatakka ubbaa shiishshidi sargezaso imath kunththida.
«Kawoykka xeygettida imaththaa beyanaas soo geliza wode sarge may7o may7ontta as demmides.
‹Haysso! Sarge may7o may7ontta waanada haa gelanaas dandayadii?› gi oychchiin addezas zaarana qaalay dhaydes.
Kawoykka ba ashkarata, ‹Hayssa addeza tohonne kushe shiishshi qachchidi heen karen diza dhumaan kessi olite; heen yeehonne achcha garccech gidana.›
«Xeygettidayti darota; doorettidayti gidikko guuththata» gi yootides.
Giira Qanxxanaas Shiiqida Oysho
Hessafe guye Farsaaweti kezi bishe, «Iza doonappe bala qaala wostti demmi oykkinoo?» giidi zorettida.

Bana kaallizayta Herdoosa asatara izakko kiittidi, «Astamaaree! Neni tumanchchanne Xoossa oge tumappe tamaarsizaade gididayssanne oonaska dumma maado ooththontta ubbaaka issi mala ne xeellizayssa nu eroos.
Nees ay misatizaakko ane nuus yoota; Qeesaares giira qanxxanaas bessizee? Bessennee?» gida.
Yesusikka istta gene qofaa eridi, «Intteno qoodheppe qommon hanizaytoo! Tana yo7on baleththi oykkanaas aazas koyeetii?
Intte giira qanxxiza miishshaa ane tana bessite» giin isttika issi dinaare geetettiza miish izas ehida.
Izikka, «Hayssa miishshaa bolla diza misleynne xaafettida sunththay oonayssee?» gides.
Isttika izas, «Qeesaareyssa» gida. Izikka isttas zaaridi, «Qeesaareyssa Qeesaares, Xoossayssa Xoossas immite» gides.
Hessa siyidi istti malalettidi iza aggi bida.
Hayqqidayta Denththa Gishshas Shiiqida Oysho
«Hayqqidaytas dendoy baa» giidi ammaniza Saduqaaweti he gallas Yesusaakko shiiqidi,
«Astamaaree! Musey, ‹Issaadey machcho ekkidi naa yelontta hayqqiko iza ishay hayqqidayssa machcho ekkidi ba ishaa laattiza naa izas yelo› gides.
Nu achchan laappun ishati deettes shin koyro ishay machcho ekkidi naa yelontta hayqqida gishshas kaalo ishay iza machcheyo ekkides.
Nam7anththo ishaykka hayqqida ishaaththo naa yelontta hayqqides; hessaththoka hanishin maccassaya laappunththa ishaa geladus.
Wurseththan maccassaya hayqqadus.
Hessa gishshas laappunati wurikka izo ekkidashin hayqoppe denththa gallas maccassaya laappunatappe awayssa machcho gidanee?» gida.
Yesusikka isttas zaaridi, «Geeshsha Maxaafatanne Xoossa wolqqa intte erontta gishshas baletteeta.
Hayqoppe dendidaappe guye asay salo kiitanchchata mala gidana attiin eketettenanne gelettenna.

Hayqqidayta denththa gishshas gidikko Xoossi, ‹Tani Abrahaame Xoossa, Yisaaqa Xoossa, Yaaqoobe Xoossa› giidi inttes yootoyssa nababibeekketii? Xoossi paxata Xoossa attiin hayqeththata Xoos gidenna» gides.
Derezikka hessa siyidi iza timirtezan malalettides.
Ubbaafe Aadhdhiza Azazo
Yesusi Saduqaaweta co7u histtidayssa siyidi Farsaaweti issi bolla shiiqettida.
Istta giddofe issi Muse wogaa lo7eththi erizaadey Yesusa paaccanaas koyidi, «Astamaaree! Muse wogata giddon ubbaafe aadhdhizay awayssee?» giidi oychchides.
Izikka zaaridi, « ‹Ne Godaa Xoossa ne kumeththa wozinappe, ne kumeththa shemppofe, ne kumeththa qofappe dosa.›
Hayssi koyronne ubbaafe aadhdhiza azazo.
Nam7anththoyka iza misatees, hessika, ‹Ne shooro ne hu7e mala dosa› gizayssa.
Muse wogaynne nabeta timirtey wurikka hayta nam7u azazotan qashettees» gides.
Kirstoosa Gishshas Shiiqida Oysho
Farsaaweti issi bolla shiiqetti dishin Yesusi istta,
«Kirstoosa gishshas intte ay geetii? Izi oona naa?» gi oychchides; isttika izas zaaridi, «Izi Dawite naa» gida.
Izikka isttas,
Hessa gishshas Dawiti iza, ‹Ta Godaa› giidi xeygikko waanidi izas naa gidana dandayzee?» gides.
Izas issi qaala zaarana dandayda asi woykko he gallassafe simmiin iza oysho oychchana xalida asi oonikka beettibeenna.
